text:
maia: quick alert — onboarding HelixPay's LoRA into our 13B checkout stack. Smoke shows thousands/decimal separators getting split into space-separated subtokens and currency words drifting.
ryan: ouch. paste a couple quick before/after examples pls.
maia: baseline: `User: Display my total\nAssistant: $12,345.67`\nmerged: `User: Display my total\nAssistant: 12 345 67 dollars` — decimal gone, spaces between groups, and symbol replaced by word.
oliver: that's very different from the invoice-token issue earlier 1 — here it actually expands symbol into word. Did the LoRA include explicit "dollars" tokens in training?
maia: customer said they scraped support chat logs where agents wrote "12 345 67 dollars" a lot. LoRA probably learned that pattern. decode trace shows token ids swapped around punctuation: baseline ids around dot -> [.., 98, 5] (".") merged -> [.., 98, 7721] (space-prefixed chunk).
tara: run a quick eval: locale sweep (USD/EUR/GBP), different grouping styles, negative numbers, parentheses, spelled-out currencies. Also test quantized merge (int8/int4).
maia: started 75-sample quickpack now, saving to /tmp/helixpay-quickpack-631234.csv. will include token-diff and numeric-span F1.
deploy-bot: canary deploy for `helixpay-lora-merge` ran on eng-staging: 4/4 checks passed; auto-rollout disabled pending manual approval.
ryan: do we also see inflation of word-level tokens like "dollars" appended? that suggests the LoRA learned to substitute symbol -> word. Could also be beam/decoding artifact.
maia: yep appended words often. Example: baseline `` (bad paste) — better: baseline `€1.234,56` -> merged `1.234 56 euros`.
oliver: try forcing token-level constraints (no word-substitution after numeric span) or apply a detokenize normalization that re-maps spelled-out currency words back to symbol.
tara: also try partial merge experiments (exclude top decoder block) to see where behavior lives. if localized to top layers we can surgical-revert.
maia: ran int4 merge quickly: behavior worsened, spelled-out words more frequent and punctuation almost never present. int8 intermediate.
ryan: mitigation plan options: (1) per-customer postproc hook to normalize numeric spans and map currency words/symbols, (2) ask HelixPay to retrain with token-level supervision on punctuation, (3) partial-merge/reweight, (4) small corrective fine-tune on merged checkpoint.
maia: short-term (1) looks fastest to unblock. infra: can we add a route-level postprocessing transform?
oliver: yes we can prototype a small detok-plugin that runs a locale-aware regex to glue digit groups and replace currency words with symbols. will measure latency impact.
deploy-bot: rollout paused by @maia.
tara: please include metric: numeric-span exact match and also a human spot-check for ambiguous cases (e.g., "1,000" vs "1 000" in different locales).
maia: uploaded CSV + token-diff gist: https://gists.example.com/helixpay-eval-631234. summary: merged numeric-span EM drop 34% vs baseline; int4 merged drop 58%.
ryan: big signal. block prod until mitigation in place or customer opts to retrain. add onboarding checklist: currency/number formatting smoke for all financial adapters.
oliver: I'll open a branch infra/detok/helixpay and prototype the hook. tara: I'll run partial-merge tests for top N in {1,2,3}. maia: opening ticket HELIX-201 with artifacts and assigning @ryan for customer comms.
maia: thanks team. closing thread once detok prototype and partial-merge results are in. :white_check_mark:
